info.title: Koshi MCP Server
info.description: Koshi (講師) is a Model Context Protocol server that brings retrieval, context engineering, persistent memory, and quality scoring to any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.). 100% offline — no API keys, no embeddings, no cloud required.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Koshi MCP Server — local-first retrieval, memory, context, and quality
tools for any LLM workflow. Speaks JSON-RPC over stdio.
